displaying-content-on-the-athan-clock.title: Displaying Content on the Athan Clock

blocks.html: COMING SOON

Masjidal’s Athan Frame is the next generation Athan Clock for homes and offices. In addition to prayer timings, it also display Verses, Hadith, duas and other content as an Islamic reminder all day long.

The Athan clock can be synched to your Masjid to display your Masjid’s prayer timings. This feature is available for free to your Masjid and is designed to encourage users to come to the Masjid for congregational prayers.
With our latest feature release, you can also display announcements, events and images on the Athan Frame. This will help users to stay connected with your Masjid.

Please note that the content has to be added before midnight to be displayed the next day. Athan Frames will not refresh immediately when you add new content so add the content ahead of time for it to be displayed correctly.
This feature is available for premium or ultimate plans.

taraweeh-timings.title: Taraweeh Timings

blocks.html: Taraweeh prayers hold special significance during Ramadan, and having accurate prayer schedules ensures that worshippers can plan accordingly.

With this feature, Masjids can display Taraweeh prayer timings on the Al-Iqamah app, and the Athan+ app, helping the community stay informed about the start and end times of nightly prayers. This makes it easier for attendees to organize their schedule and attend prayers on time.

Please update your Al-Iqamah app to the latest version (Signage Players – version 602 or higher, Amazon – Version 207 or higher, Google Playstore – Version 405 or higher. If you are not on the correct version, this will not work correctly.
You can display two sets of tarweeh timings, including the reciters and locations.
To set taraweeh timings, login to your Masjidal account. Click on Others in the left navigation bar under Timings.
Select the Taraweeh Timings tab and click Add Timing:
Enter the following:
Title – Enter the title of the taraweeh. This would generally be Taraweeh 1 or 2.
Subtitle – This will be the location where the taraweeh is being performed.
Reciter – The imam of the specific taraweeh. This is limited to one imam.
Time – By default, this is offset from Isha Iqamah. If set to 10, it means Taraweeh will start 10mins after Isha Iqamah. To change this to a fixed timing, select the dropdown and change to fixed.
Click save.
To display these taraweeh timings onto Al-Iqamah. Click on New Content in the left navigation bar under Slideshow.
Select the Taraweeh Timings tile:

Check the box that asks if you would like to display Fajr & Maghrib timings (optional).

Check the radio button to display on Full or Split Screen.

Choose which zone to display on or leave as All.
Schedule – Set as per your preference.
Click save.
Note that by adding Taraweeh Timings, they will automatically be displayed on the Athan+ app* as shown below:
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.

taraweeh-timings.desc: Set and display Taraweeh prayer times so your community can follow the Ramadan schedule.

tv-guide.title: Displaying on Masjid TV

blocks.html: Quick Setup Guide
There are a few different options available for you to display the prayer timings on your TV.
Option 1: Masjidal Signage Player

You can order the Signage player from our site. The signage player is a small device that connects to WiFi or Ethernet and comes with an HDMI cable. You can connect it to your TV using an HDMI cable. Its designed for Masjid’s so it does not display any movie trailers, ads or any inappropriate content.
Option 2: Amazon Firestick or Amazon TV
If you have an Amazon TV or an Amazon Firestick, you can download the Al-Iqamah app from the Amazon App store. After downloading the app, search for your Masjid.
Option 3: Android TV, Chromecast or Android TV Device

You can download the Al-Iqamah app from the Google Play store on your Android device. After downloading the app, search for your Masjid. Please note that this app is not designed for small screens such as phones and tablets. It’s designed for big screens such as TV screens.
Next Step

After downloading and installing the Al-Iqamah app, please launch the app and search for your Masjid. Please make sure that your Masjid is approved for listing otherwsie it will not show up in the search result.
Enter your Masjid name and click the search button
Click on the Masjid from the list

widget.title: Website Widgets
widget.source: Masjidal portal widget editor and installation guide, supplied screenshots

blocks.html: Add prayer times and announcements to your masjid website using the widget editor in the Masjidal portal. Customize the appearance, publish your settings, and copy the embed code for each widget.

Professional plan

Extra colors and theme options require the Professional plan. The options available in your account depend on your plan.
1. Open the widget editor

1. Sign in to your Masjidal portal and select the correct masjid.
  2. In the left menu, open Integrations → Widgets.
  3. The editor shows previews for Prayer Times and Announcements. Use Installation Guide for the installation steps.

blocks.alt: Masjidal portal showing Integrations, Widgets, appearance controls, and prayer times and announcements previews

blocks.html: 2. Add the widget library to your website
Add this script once inside your website’s <head> tag, on the pages where the widgets will appear:

<script
  async
  src="https://widgets.masjidal.com/timetable/v0/widget.js">
</script>
This loads the widget library. You will add the individual widget snippets where you want the prayer times or announcements to appear.
3. Customize the widgets
Global appearance

• Dark Mode: choose Light, Auto, or Dark.
  • Accent Color: select an available color. Extra colors and theme options require the Professional plan.
Prayer times

• Layout: choose from the options available for your plan. The editor shows Grid, Table, Table 2, Ribbon, Compact, and Minimal Bar.
  • Header: select Masjid Name, Prayer Timings, or Hide.
  • Hijri Date Changes At: choose Midnight or Maghrib.
Announcements
Choose an available layout: Stacked, Compact, or Ribbon. Check the preview to see how your announcements will look.
Open Advanced Settings if you need to adjust the additional controls available in your account.

blocks.alt: Widget editor showing prayer and announcement layout options, Advanced Settings, and the Publish button

blocks.html: 4. Publish your settings
When you are happy with both previews, click Publish at the bottom of the settings panel to save the widget configuration. Install the library and publish your settings before embedding the widgets.
5. Embed prayer times or announcements

1. Click Embed above the Prayer Times or Announcements preview.
  2. The portal fills in your frontend key automatically. Manage your keys and allowed website domains under Integrations → API Keys.
  3. Click Copy and paste the complete snippet into your website’s HTML where you want the widget to appear.
  4. For both widgets, copy and place each snippet separately. Load the library script only once on the page.
Prayer times example
These examples use placeholders. Copy your own complete snippet from the portal instead of using these values.

<masjidal-widget
  async
  widget-id="YOUR_WIDGET_ID"
  type="prayer"
  api-key="YOUR_FRONTEND_KEY">
</masjidal-widget>
Announcements example

<masjidal-widget
  async
  widget-id="YOUR_WIDGET_ID"
  type="announcement"
  api-key="YOUR_FRONTEND_KEY">
</masjidal-widget>

Use a frontend key

Website widgets use a frontend key beginning with msj_pk_. Add your website domain to its allowed domains in API Keys. Never put a server key beginning with msj_sk_ in website HTML or browser JavaScript.
Installing on WordPress

1. Add the library script to the site’s head using your theme’s supported integration field or an approved header-code tool. If the page uses Divi, its Theme Options → Integration area may provide a head-code field.
  2. Edit the page and add a Custom HTML block, or a Code module in Divi.
  3. Paste the actual widget snippet copied from the portal into that block or module.
  4. Save the page, clear any page cache, and check the published page on a phone and a desktop.
Your WordPress account must be allowed to save custom HTML and scripts. If your editor removes the code, ask your site administrator to install it through the site’s supported code-insertion method.
If a widget does not display

• Confirm that the library script is installed and loads on the page.
  • Confirm that you clicked Publish in the widget editor.
  • Copy the full embed snippet again and check the widget ID, type, and frontend key.
  • Check the actual website domain is allowed under Integrations → API Keys.
  • Check the snippet is in a Custom HTML block or Code module, rather than a normal text paragraph.
  • Clear website caches and reload the published page.
Need help? Email masjidsupport@masjidal.com.

widget.desc: Customize, publish, and embed prayer times and announcements from Integrations → Widgets in the Masjidal portal.

announcements-as-text.title: Announcements

blocks.html: ATHAN+ Phone App for your Masjid

Keep your community informed with real-time announcements on Athan+. Share important updates like Eid prayers, funerals, and fundraisers through color-coded text boxes or image-based slides. Announcements can be tapped to view fullscreen, shared easily, and even linked to your website. You can schedule them in advance and display them on the app or your masjid screens with just a few clicks.
Click here to learn more about the Athan+ phone app.
Announcements as Text

You can add various announcement messages such Eid Prayer reminders, fundraisers, funeral information and so on. The announcement texts appear as color coded announcement boxes. User can tap on it to view it in fullscreen. They can also easily share with their contacts by tapping the share icon.
To add an announcement text,click on the New Content link on the left navigation bar and then click on the  Announcement tile.
Title – Enter the title of the announcement. Best practice is to keep it short and direct for maximum impact.

Type – Regular will appear as a text box. Important will appear as a red text box and will appear as a one-time pop up when the view your masjid on the Athan+ app. Obituary will appear as a green text box. Donation will appear as a green box with a link to donate directly from the announcement. Button is described further down.
Message – Enter the detailed message here. Best practice is to keep it simple and direct.
Schedule – Enter the date range that this should be active for.
Display On – Select Athan+ for the Athan+ app. Checking Screens will show the text on the Al-Iqamah app (masjid signage).
Click the Save button to save the announcement.
Announcements as Slides (premium feature)

You can add clickable sliders (images) to enhance your Masjid listing on the Athan+ app. The images can also be displayed on the Al-Iqamah app (masjid signage screens) with a simple checkbox making it easy to manage your content and display it on various platforms.
Click on the Slideshow in the dropdown and then Image.
Name – Enter a descriptive name for this slide.
Display On – Select Athan+. Checking Al-Iqamah will show the text on the Al-Iqamah app (masjid signage).
Upload Image – Click on Choose File to upload the image to be displayed. Best practice is to create a 1920px x 1080px sized image.

Image Click URL (Optional) – Enter the website link if you want users to be redirected to a specific page on your Masjid’s website. This allows the user to tap on the image and be redirected to a website. Leaving it blank will disable the clicking on the app.
Schedule (Optional) – Enter specific dates and times in which you would like the image to be displayed.
Click the Save button to save the slide.

announcements-as-text.desc: Publish announcements and keep your community informed through the Athan+ phone app.

announcements.title: Announcements

blocks.html: Easily display texts such as Eid Prayer reminders, fundraisers, funeral information etc. on your screens. Announcement texts can either be displayed in full screen, split screen or as scrolling text (ticker) at the bottom of the timing screen.
Adding Announcements

Login to your Masjidal account. If you haven’t signed up for your Masjid, please sign up, its free. After login in, click on the New Content link on the left navigation bar and then click on the  Announcement tile.
Enter the following:
Title – Enter the title of the announcement. Best practice is to keep it short and direct for maximum impact.
Type – Regular will appear as a scrolling text on the prayer (Iqamah) time screen. All other types will be displayed as scrolling, full screen or split screen (described below).
Message – Enter the detailed message here. Best practice is to keep it simple and direct.
Select “Al-Iqamah” to display this announcement on the Al-Iqamah app (TV Screens in the Masjid). Note: Selecting “Athan+” will display the same announcement on the Athan+ (phone) app (learn more).
Select zone(s) if you want to display this on specific TVs. Leave it as All if you want to display this on all TVs.
Enter the Date Range – the date range that this should be active for.
Click the Save button to create the announcement.
Setting on the App
Announcements as Full or Split screen (premium feature)
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
The setting to display announcements as full/split screen can be managed in the Al-Iqamah app. Click on the Masjidal logo on the bottom right on the prayer timing screen:

Click on the checkbox for “Fullscreen Announcements Notification” and enter the duration for the announcement. Checking this box will display all announcements (except “regular” announcement type) in either full screen or split screen:
SPLIT SCREEN: Click on the checkbox “Notification in Split Screen” to display all announcements and Iqamah change notifications in split screen (screen with timings).
Click “SAVE” button to save the settings.
Fullscreen Announcement

athan-time.title: Athan Time

blocks.html: ATHAN TIME (Exception Cases)
Some Masjids want to display 3 timings – Salah (start), Athan and Iqamah timings. Athan timings are an exception, by default, Masjidal supports the Salah (start) and Iqamah timings.
If you want to display the Athan timings, please follow the steps below.
Please note that the Athan timings are only supported on limited prayer timing screen (see below). Website widgets and Athan+ phone app will not display the Athan timings.
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
Click on Other under the Timings section in the left navigation bar. Then select the Athan Timings tab, and turn on the toggle button for Display Athan time…
Then, enter the offsets for each salah and click save:
Note: Offsets are the number of minutes Athan is called before Iqamah time for each prayer.

For example, if Athan is called 10 minutes before Fajr Iqamah, enter 10 for Fajr. The system will automatically display the actual time for Athan based on Iqamah. When Iqamah time changes, system will automatically adjust Athan time to reflect that.
To display the timings on the TV screen, click on the Al-Iqamah tab under Settings and then select “Gray (Premium)” for the timing screen. Click the save button to reflect the changes on the screen.

athan-time.desc: Manage the Athan times shown to your community in the Athan+ phone app.

countdown-screens.title: Countdown Screens (Seconds)

blocks.html: Automatically display a one minute countdown screen to Athan (start time) and Iqamah time.
This is a premium feature available to Al-Iqamah Professional accounts only (paid feature). Subscription is needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
By default, this screen is turned off. This option is set in the app at the device level (device connected to the TV) so that every device on your account doesn’t display this notification.
To activate this setting, click on the Masjidal logo (bottom right) on the timing screen. Easiest way to click is using a USB mouse connected to the device. The setting screen in the app will open.

To enable it, click the checkbox for “Fullscreen 1-Minute Countdown to Athan/Iqamah“. Click “Save” when you are finished with enabling this screen. That’s it, the countdown screen should be displayed in full screen when 1 minute or less is left to Athan to Iqamah time.
Please update your app to the latest version for this feature to work.

default-icons.title: Buttons

blocks.html: Deault Icons & Custom Buttons for your ATHAN+ Phone App

Bring your Masjid’s content to users with ease. Athan+ lets you add buttons to your app that instantly connect users to important pages like Events, Donation, and the Monthly Timetable. With just a few clicks, you can enable default icons or create custom buttons tailored to your Masjid’s needs. Whether it’s volunteer signups, live streams, or special announcements, these buttons keep your community engaged. Everything is easy to set up from the Athan+ dashboard—no technical skills required.
Click here to learn more about the Athan+ phone app.
Default Icons (premium feature)
You can add the 3 default icons to redirect users to specific webpages, including Events, Donation, and Monthly Timetable. These buttons will show up on the bottom of the users screen.

To add these, go into the Athan+ section in the sidebar. Paste the corresponding link into the text boxes. If you use the masjidal donation platform, you do not need to add anything for donation URL. It will show up automatically. For monthly timetable, click select theme.
Custom Buttons (premium feature)

In addition to the default icons, you can add upto 3 custom buttons to redirect users to specific webpages such as volunteer signup, special donation request, live streaming and so on to enhance your Masjid listing on the Athan+ app.
To add a custom button, click on the Add button on the same Athan+ page.
Button Label – Enter the label for the button. Best practice is to keep it short and in uppercase.
URL – Enter the URL of the webpage for the users to be directed to. Do not enter anything else besides the full URL.
Schedule – Entering the Start Date for the button is mandatory. End Date is optional.
Click the Save button to save the button.

default-icons.desc: Customize the buttons and shortcuts available on your Al-Iqamah display.

blocks.html: Easily display funeral announcements on your screens. Funeral announcement can either be displayed in full screen or split screen.
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
Adding Announcements

Login to your Masjidal account. If you haven’t signed up for your Masjid, please sign up, its free. After login in, click on the Slideshow link on the left navigation bar and select New Content. Then, click on Announcement.
Type – Select Obituary.
Title – Enter the name of the deceased.
Message – Enter the details such as funeral time/date and burial information. Include line breaks to make it easier to read on the screen (see below image as an example).
Zone – “All” will display this on all screens (if you have multiple ones) otherwise select a Zone that you want to display this on.
Display On – “Al-Iqamah” will show the text on the Al-Iqamah app (masjid signage). Note: Selecting others will display the same announcement on the other platforms such as Athan+ (phone) app.
Schedule – Enter the date range that this should be active for.
Click the Save button.
Setting on the App
Announcements as Full or Split screen (premium feature)
The setting to display announcements as full/split screen can be managed in the Al-Iqamah app. Click on the Masjidal logo on the bottom right on the prayer timing screen:

Click on the checkbox for “Fullscreen Announcements Notification” and enter the duration for the announcement. Checking this box will display all announcements (except “regular” announcement type) in either full screen or split screen:
SPLIT SCREEN: Click on the checkbox “Notification in Split Screen” to display all announcements and Iqamah change notifications in split screen (screen with timings).
Click “SAVE” button to save the settings.
Split Screen Announcement

funeral-announcement.desc: Enter funeral details and display an announcement for your community.

google-slides.title: Google Slides

blocks.html: Google slides can be displayed on the screen easily. Follow these steps to correctly display your Google slides.

Google slides will be part of the overall slides displayed on your screen. For example, by default, the prayer timing screen will be displayed then any other content that you added or content generated automatically (announcements and iqamah changes). Each one will be displayed in a sequence and the duration will be set separatley for each content. Google slides will be displayed in the same manner so the duration for each Google slide has to be set in the URL provided.
Best practise is to display Google Slides with limited slides (upto 3 at the most).
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
Open your Google Slide. Click on File -> Sahre -> Publish to web:

By default, each slide will be displayed for 3 seconds. Change this to atleast 5 seconds. Select the checbox for “Start slideshow as soon as the player loads” and “Restart the slideshow after the last slide”.
Copy the URL for the next step.
Click on the Slideshow link on the left navigation bar and select New Content. Then, click on Website.
Give it a name and fill in the fields as needed to schedule it correctly. Zone can also be selected to display this on specific screens only.

The duration listed on this screen is the duration for the entire Google slide and not individual slides in your Google slide. For example, if your Google slide has 3 slides and you selected 5 seconds for each slide, the duration here should be 15 seconds so that all the slides can be displayed. Click Save and that’s it, your Google slide will be displayed based on these settings.
For more information about scheduling, click here.
NOTE: To display the Google Slides in split screen, check the “Split Screen” radio button.

iqamah-change-notifications.title: Iqamah Change Notifications

blocks.html: When Iqamah time changes within 3 days of the current date, an automatic announcement message is generated by default. The message keeps everyone informed of the upcoming time changes.
The message can be displayed in the following ways.
Scrolling Notification (default)
If Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr or Isha Iqamah is changing within 3 days, a scrolling message at the bottom of the timing screen will be displayed:
Full / Split Screen Notification (Premium Feature)
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
Instead of a scrolling message, you can select an option to display the Iqamah change notification in full or split screen. This option is more noticeable and easier to read from a distance.
This option is set in the Al-Iqamah app at the device level (device connected to the TV) so that different devices on your account can display this notification differently.
To activate this setting, click on the Masjidal logo (bottom right) on the timing screen. Easiest way to click is using a USB mouse connected to the device. The setting screen in the app will open.
Click the checkbox “Fullscreen Iqamah Change Notification” and enter the duration in seconds.
SPLIT SCREEN: Click on the checkbox “Notification in Split Screen” to display all announcements and Iqamah change notifications in split screen (screen with timings).
Click “SAVE” button to save the settings.
That’s it, the Iqamah change should be displayed in full or split screen for this device.
NEW – Color Coded Notification (Premium Feature)
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
In addition to the Full or Split screen Iqamah change notification, you can also display a color coded notification on the timing screen so that the notification is constantly displayed.
The notification will be blue if the Iqamah time is changing in 3 days, green if its changing in 2 days and red if its changing the next day.
To activate it, simply click on the Masjidal logo (bottom right) on the timing screen and check the box to  “Display Color-coded Iqamah Change Notification on Timing Screen”. Click the Save button.
Please note that this is a newly released feature. If you don’t see this option, please update Al-Iqamah to the latest version.

Quick Tip: Optionally, you can also change the number of days that the Iqamah check should be done for (1, 2 or 3 days). And you can stop Iqamah change notifications for specific Iqamahs by simply unchecking the box for that Iqamah.

iqamah-change-notifications.desc: Automatically notify worshippers when an upcoming Iqamah time changes.

iqamah.title: Iqamah

blocks.html: IQAMAH TIME MANAGEMENT
You can easily setup iqama timings using the Iqama tab. Enter Iqama timings directly (recommended) or mass upload your timings using the provided template.
Click on the Iqamah Timings under the Timings section in the left navigation bar.
On this page, you can Create/Copy/Delete Iqamah timings. You can also view or edit previously saved Iqamah timings. Two Options are available for entering Iqamah timings in the system.
NOTE: Only enter Iqamah times when there is a change.

Enter the date when Iqamah is changing and then enter the Iqamah times for that date. These times will be used till the next date when a change happens is reached. For example, Iqamah times are changing on June 21 and July 1 => Enter Iqamah times ONLY for June 21 and July 1.

From June 21 to June 30, the Iqamah times will be based on the June 21 entry. On July 1, the new Iqamah times will be displayed. Notice that there is no Iqamah times entered for June 22 to June 30 as the system will use the June 21 Iqamah times till the date is July 1. This way, you don’t need to enter daily Iqamah times but only on changes.
Option 1
To enter Iqamah times manually (recommended), click on the ADD button: nter the date and then the timings and then click on the CREATE button to save the timings:
Enter the date and then the timings and then click on the ADD button to save the timings:
Option 2

To upload Iqamah times, click on the UPLOAD button, download the template and enter the timings in the excel template. Create a CSV from the excel template and upload it by clicking the CHOOSE file button and then UPLOAD button.
Editing/Deleting Times
To EDIT, DUPLICATE or DELETE Iqamah timings, click on the respective icons on the right of each row:
Setup Salah Times – Follow the steps on this help article -> Salah Time Management

iqamah.desc: Set and manage Iqamah times for your masjid and keep your community up to date.

masjid-information.title: App Setup

blocks.html: ATHAN+ Phone App for your Masjid

Reach thousands of users with minimal effort. Athan+ is the only Athan App that finds nearby Masjids based on the user’s location and displays the Iqamah timing of all the nearby Masjids along with the prayer timings. In addition to the Iqamah timings for your Masjid, there are a lot of other features that are available to you to engage with the app users.
Click here to learn more about the Athan+ phone app.
Your Masjid Data

Login to your Masjidal account. If you haven’t signed up for your Masjid, please sign up, its free. After login in, click on the Account dropdown on the left navigation bar and then the Masjid Info tab.
Complete the website, phone, email and the address fields. Click the Save button.
After saving, your Masjid information will be displayed on the Athan+ app.
Premium Features (learn more)
In addition to the free content that can be displayed for your Masjid, you can upgrade to a premium account to unlock the full potential of the Athan+ app.

Donation Website Page Url – Enter your Masjid’s donation page URL. By adding this link, a “Donate” button will appear on your Masjid screen in the Athan+ app encouraging users to donate easily and frequently. Some Masjids have already raised over $100k through the Athan+ app. As a best practise, this should be a simple mobile friendly page that would allow the user to quickly donate to your Masjid. Please note that Masjidal does not collect or process the donations. The donations are processed through your Masjid’s website or PayPal account and paid directly to your Masjid.
Google Calendar Url for Events – If you manage a Google calendar for your Masjid, add the link here and the events will be displayed on the Athan+ app.
QR Registration URL – Adding the prayer registration link here will display a button in the Athan+ app to allow users to easily register for your Masjid.

Monthly Prayer Timing URL – Enter your Masjid’s monthly prayer link (web or pdf). This will add a link on the Athan+ app to your monthly timetable. If you don’t have a monthly timetable, simply add the dynamic link from you Masjidal account (learn more).
Logo – Brand your Masjid page by uploading your Masjid’s logo. The logo should be in PNG or JPG format and should be smaller than 200 px.

prohibited-salah-time.title: Prohibited Salah Time

blocks.html: Automatically display a screen during prohibited salah times. There are 3 times when this screen can be activated. During these times, the screen will show a countdown and a message stating that it’s prohibited salah time.
By default, this screen is turned off. This option is set in the app at the device level (device connected to the TV) so that every device on your account doesn’t display this notification.
To activate this setting, click on the Masjidal logo (bottom right) on the timing screen. Eaiset way to click is using a USB mouse connected to the device. The setting screen in the app will open.

You will have 3 different options of when to display this notification. Tulu time starts at sunrise, zawal end at dhuhr time and ghurub ends at maghrib time. To enable it, click the checkbox under the title “Display Prohibited Time Screen” for the time that you want it enabled for. A popup will appear for you to enter the number of minutes it should display for. For example for tulu, it will start at sunrise and end based on the number of minutes that you enter. Click “Done” when you are finished with enabling this notification. That’s it, the prohibited time screen should be displayed in full screen.
Please update your app to the latest version for this feature to work.

push-notifications.title: Push Notifications

blocks.html: Push Notifications on the ATHAN+ Phone App
Push notifications are messages that pop up on a user’s mobile phone. These little banners slide into view — whether or not the app is open.
Any user that has your Masjid set as their favorite Masjid will receive the notification (user’s can also opt out of it in the settings).

Push notification is a Premium feature (learn more). Even for Masjid’s that are signed for Athan+ Professional, it needs to be activated. Please send an email to salman@masjidal.com to have this feature enabled for your Masjid.
Click here to learn more about the Athan+ phone app.
Sending Push Notifications

Login to your Masjidal account. If you haven’t signed up for your Masjid, please sign up, its free. After logging in, click on the Settings link on the left navigation bar and then then select Athan+.
Click on the Push Notifications tab and click Create.
Title – Give it a meaningful title. Something short and to the point. The title will show up when the user taps the push notification.
Message – Provide more detail on this field. Best practice is to keep it clear and easy to understand.
Enter the following details and click Send.
Notifications cannot be changed or deleted. User’s will see what you are sending so please double check and triple check the message before sending it.
Notifications cannot be sent between 10pm to 8am Masjid’s time. This is so that the user’s are not disturbed at odd hours.
Notifications are limited to 3 within a 7 day period.
The notification will be displayed on the user’s phone within an hour:
Tapping on the notification will show it as a pop up:

push-notifications.desc: Send push notifications to people following your masjid in the Athan+ app.

salah.title: Salah (Athan)

blocks.html: SALAH TIME MANAGEMENT
You can easily setup salah (athan) timings using the Salah tab. Save the settings for calculating salah times or mass upload your timings using the provided template.
Click on the Salah Timings under the Timings section in the left navigation bar.
On this page, you can set the calculation methods used for calculating the salah times. The times are calculated based on the Masjid location (longitude and latitude) and the settings on this page.

Select the calculation and asr method that you follow. If needed, set the custom angles – angles are generally not needed as they are based on the calculation method selected and will default. Click the Save button to generate the timings for your review.
NOTE: Click on the Save button after you make any changes to the “Methods” or “Offsets” section. After saving, the timings will generate with the new setting and will override existing timings.
If the timings look correct, then you are all set. Timings will be automatically generated every month based on these settings.
If any adjustments are needed, you can use offsets to add/subtract minutes from the generated timings.

To view the timings for another month, enter the month in the Month Range field and click on the Generate button. This will display the timings for that month using the settings that you have saved. This is just for verifying the timings, they don’t need to be generated every month as they will be automatically calculated.
Manually Uploading Timings

If you prefer to load your own timings,  click on Download button to get the excel template.  Follow the instructions and create CSV file. Click on Choose file to select the CSV file and then click Upload to load the timings from the file. Scroll down to verify that the timings are correct.

salah.desc: Configure Salah and Athan timings for your masjid.

settings.title: Settings

blocks.html: Some settings for Al-Iqamah are based on the app side and are reflected on the specific screen.
To access the settings screen, click on the Masjidal logo on the screen:
Basic Settings

Launch App Without Internet – Select this checkbox if you want the Al-Iqamah to start without internet. Default and recommended setting is to leave this unchecked as internet connection is needed for the signage to work correctly.

Start After Boot – This allows the Al-Iqamah app to automatically launch after the device starts up (incase of power failure and so on). Recommended setting is to leave it checked. The time in seconds is the delay before the app is launched. This ensures that wifi connection is established before the app is launched.

No Reminder/Beep for Jumu’ah – Select this checkbox if you don’t want to display the “reminder” screen during Jumu’ah time. Default setting is unchecked so that the reminder screen is displayed on Jumu’ah’s as well.

Ignore every Iqamah Slide for Jumu’ah – Select this checkbox if you don’t want to display the slide(s) set as “Every Iqamah” during Jumu’ah time. Default setting is unchecked so that the slide(s) are displayed on Jumu’ah’s as well.
Scrolling Text Speed – Use the slider to adjust the speed of the ticker scrolling message on the prayer timings screen.
Time Settings
24 Hour Format Time – Select this checkbox if you want to display the timings in 24-hour format.
Display Seconds in Current Time – Use this option to display the seconds in the current time.
Display Time without AM/PM – Select this checkbox to display the Salah and Iqamah times without the AM/PM. In some screens, this make the timings larger and the screen looks less busy.
Premium Settings
*Subscription needed to enable this feature. Start your 15-day free trial now.
Device Zone – You can assign a screen to a Zone so that specific content can be displayed on it. This way, you can show different content on different screens. Click here for zone settings.

Orientation – Landcape format is the default setting and supports all themes and features. If you have your screen in Portrait oreintation then you cna select a theme from the dropdown. Please note that portrait mode supports limited functionality.

Slideshow Only – By default, all screens will display the timings screen. If you have multiple screens and would like this screen to only show the content that you upload, please check this box so that the timing screen will not be displayed on this screen.

Display Time on Slides – Check this box if you want to display the current time on the top right on slides. This has a very limited use-case so please make sure that your images for the slides are designed accordingly.
Auto-close Manual Slideshow (Timeout) – Not supported, future use.
Activate Manual Slideshow – Not supported, future use.

Continous Iqamah Screen Setting – This setting to control what’s displayed on the screen right after Iqamah time. By default, it will be using the setting from your Masjidal account. If you want this device to ignore the account based setting then select the Ignore option from the dropdown. If you want to display a blank screen (silence please) during Jamaat time, then select the Blank/No Screen option and enter the number of minutes for this screen to be displayed. This option is to reduce any distraction during salah and should only be used on screens in the prayer hall area.

Notification in Split Screen – Select this option if you want the Iqamah Change Notification, Announcements and Prohibited Timings screens to be displayed in split screen. By default, this is unchecked so that the Iqamah change, announcements and prohibited times are displayed in fullscreen.
Announcement – Click here for announcement settings.
Iqamah Change Notification – Click here for Iqamah Change Notification settings.
Prohibited Salah time Screen – Click here for Prohibited Time Screen settings.

blocks.html: Taraweeh recitation schedule is designed to help your congregants follow what’s being recited during the Taraweeh. It encourages them to read the Quran and translation.
Paid subscription is needed for this feature.
To display your Taraweeh recitation schedule, follow these 3 steps.

STEP 1: Update your Al-Iqamah app to the latest version (Signage Players – version 602 or higher, Amazon – Version 207 or higher, Google Playstore – Version 405 or higher. If you are not on the correct version, this will not work correctly.

STEP 2: You will need to create the schedule for the whole month of Ramadan (or till that last day of Taraweeh if it ends before the end of Ramadan). The schedule is created as a Google slide giving you the most flexibility in managing the schedule.
To make it easy, we have created a template for you. Simply copy this template to your own Slide.
Click here to access the template

server-key-get-started.title: Get your server key
server-key-get-started.desc: Generate a server key in the portal and store it securely for your backend integration.

blocks.html:
A server key lets your backend retrieve your masjid’s prayer timings. It is a secret credential and belongs on your server.

What your key can access

A server key unlocks only GET /timings. Requests to any other Masjidal endpoint are rejected.

Generate a key

  1. Sign in to the Masjidal portal and open Integrations → API Keys.
  2. On the Server Key card, choose Generate Server Key.
  3. Copy the key and store it securely immediately. It starts with msj_sk_ and is shown only once.

Only masjid admins can generate, rotate, or disable a server key. If you lose it, open the ⋮ menu on the Server Key card and choose Rotate key.

Building a website or widget?

Use a frontend key (msj_pk_…) in browser code. Frontend keys work only from the domains you allow. Never publish a server key in a page.

timings-endpoint.title: Prayer timings endpoint
timings-endpoint.desc: Use the required date parameters and API headers to retrieve prayer timings for a chosen period.

blocks.html:
Retrieve prayer timings for a date range with the Timings endpoint.

GET https://api.masjidal.com/timings?start_date={start}&end_date={end}

Query parameters

ParameterRequired format
start_dateFirst day of the range, as YYYY-MM-DD.
end_dateLast day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after start_date.

Required headers

HeaderValue
Acceptapplication/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json
x-api-keyYour msj_sk_… key, with no quotes or Bearer prefix.

Send the Accept header on every request to select version 1. A successful request returns JSON containing the prayer timings for each day in the requested range.

Request only what you need

A month at a time is usually sufficient. Cache the results instead of requesting the same days on every page load.

server-key-request-examples.title: Make an API request
server-key-request-examples.desc: Copy backend request examples for cURL, Node.js, PHP, and Python using an environment variable.

blocks.html:
Each example reads your key from the environment variable MASJIDAL_SERVER_KEY to keep it out of source code and version control. Configure this variable on your backend or hosting platform.

Server-side examples

Run these on your backend. Never place the server key in browser JavaScript or a mobile app.

cURL

curl -G "https://api.masjidal.com/timings" \
  --data-urlencode "start_date=2026-08-01" \
  --data-urlencode "end_date=2026-08-31" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json" \
  -H "x-api-key: $MASJIDAL_SERVER_KEY"

Node.js

const params = new URLSearchParams({
  start_date: '2026-08-01',
  end_date: '2026-08-31',
});
const response = await fetch(`https://api.masjidal.com/timings?${params}`, {
  headers: {
    'Accept': 'application/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json',
    'x-api-key': process.env.MASJIDAL_SERVER_KEY,
  },
});
if (!response.ok) {
  throw new Error(`Masjidal timings request failed: ${response.status}`);
}
const timings = await response.json();

PHP

$url = 'https://api.masjidal.com/timings?' . http_build_query([
    'start_date' => '2026-08-01',
    'end_date'   => '2026-08-31',
]);
$ch = curl_init($url);
curl_setopt_array($ch, [
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => [
        'Accept: application/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json',
        'x-api-key: ' . getenv('MASJIDAL_SERVER_KEY'),
    ],
]);
$timings = json_decode(curl_exec($ch), true);
curl_close($ch);

Python

import os
import requests
response = requests.get(
    "https://api.masjidal.com/timings",
    params={"start_date": "2026-08-01", "end_date": "2026-08-31"},
    headers={
        "Accept": "application/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json",
        "x-api-key": os.environ["MASJIDAL_SERVER_KEY"],
    },
    timeout=10,
)
response.raise_for_status()
timings = response.json()

server-key-security.title: Keep your key safe
server-key-security.desc: Store credentials securely and learn when to rotate or disable a server key.

blocks.html:
Treat your server key like a password. Anyone who has it can pull your masjid’s data. It is never shown again after generation, and Masjidal support cannot recover it.

Store and use it securely

  • Keep it in an environment variable or your hosting platform’s secrets manager.
  • Call the API from your backend and pass the results to your pages.
  • Never put the key in HTML, browser JavaScript, a mobile app, or anything a visitor can view.
  • Never commit it to Git, paste it into a support ticket, or send it over chat or email.
  • Use a separate key for each masjid. Never share a key between organizations.

If a key is exposed

Open Integrations → API Keys, then the ⋮ menu on the Server Key card.

Rotate key

Issues a replacement and invalidates the old key immediately. Have the new key ready to paste into your server configuration: anything using the old key stops working as soon as you rotate it.

Disable key

Switches the key off permanently without a replacement. Use this when retiring an integration. Disabling cannot be undone; generate a fresh key to start again.

server-key-troubleshooting.title: Troubleshoot API requests
server-key-troubleshooting.desc: Resolve authorization errors, unexpected responses, date ranges, and deployment configuration issues.

blocks.html:
Request rejected as unauthorized

Check that x-api-key is present and spelled correctly. Remove stray quotes or whitespace. Confirm the value starts with msj_sk_ and has not been rotated or disabled.

Unexpected response format

Set Accept to exactly application/vnd.masjidal.com.v1+json. Some clients replace it with a default unless you set it explicitly.

Fewer days than expected, or no days

Both dates must use YYYY-MM-DD. Confirm end_date is not earlier than start_date.

It worked yesterday and fails today

Check whether someone rotated or disabled the key in the portal. Rotation takes effect immediately. Generate a new key if needed and update your server configuration.

Works locally but fails after deployment

Check that the environment variable holding your key is set in your hosting platform’s environment settings.

Need help?

Contact Masjidal support from your portal account. Never include your server key in the message.
